title: Sudoku
tagline: Nine by nine, one of each, no guessing required.
description: Sudoku, generated fresh and never unfair. Every puzzle here is made by a generator that then hands it to a solver, and only ships it if there is exactly one answer and that answer can be reached by reasoning alone — no puzzle in this game needs a guess. Four difficulties, pencil marks for the ones you are not sure of, and a daily puzzle that everyone gets the same copy of.
author: HexCave
controls: Tap a cell, then a number
howToPlay: Tap a square, then tap a number. Tap the same number again to clear it.
Switch to pencil mode to jot the candidates you have not decided between.
A number that breaks a row, column or box is flagged straight away.
goal: Fill the grid so every row, column and box holds one to nine exactly once.
